desc:
Cozy & Chill game, where you discover recipes, bake and build. 

[how to play] 
~ Buy ingredients at the stands 
~ Mix dough and batter in your Mixer 
~ Bake it in the Oven 
~ Stock your Display Case and serve customers 
~ Collect cash and upgrade your machines 
~ Discover new recipes and fill your Recipe Book 
~ Hire animal helpers to bake and sell for you 
~ Expand and decorate your bakery  

👥 Visit your friends' bakeries and buy their treats!  

👍 Click the notification bell to follow for updates!
~ Made by Bertik, Olikus and Sameek ~
